text: IETPOLI organizes also scientific conferences at international level. And your professors, Tonji, who work on electrical engineering, electronics engineering, telecommunications, so all ICP, aerospace, all of them publish papers in IETPOLI conferences and journals. Okay, so it's one of the big main, it's probably the main scientific association in the world. IETPOLI also issues standards for technologies. And the name of the standard is 802.11. Okay, now as we will see, there are many documents that compose this standard. And these documents specify the characteristics of the different versions of Wi-Fi. Why do we have many versions of Wi?
